4.label: fix-round preregistration, written after the independent review and before any fix-round rerun
4.expectation: In a fresh prefix with inspect-ai==0.3.268 and mlflow==3.16.1 pinned at install, the same frozen cases.json (sha256 checked) run through promptfoo and inspect gives identical per-case predictions (30/30 agreement) and 26/30 for both; runtime is recorded for both; token usage is recorded for both from the endpoint's billed_units, from each harness's own usage fields, and from vLLM prompt_tokens_total snapshots.
4.criteria: pinned install command; per-case agreement table; wall-clock runtime per harness; harness-reported token fields quoted (including zero/empty); vLLM metric deltas with a quiet control interval; Inspect log retained as JSON.

5.label: fix-round preregistration, written after the independent review and before any fix-round rerun
5.expectation: Twelve new cases (C9-C20) authored from retained repository sources, with labels frozen by sha256 before inference, extend the set to 20. One Codex call (read-only, ephemeral, stdin closed, --output-schema) and one bounded Claude call (--json-schema, no tools) each return a schema-valid verdict for all 20 cases, blind to labels and to TypeSafe output. TypeSafe on C9-C20 is not run: it needs an API credential the brief forbids reading. Expected outcome: advanced.
5.criteria: both outputs validate against the schema; per-case table vs frozen labels; case authoring and labelling by the same agent disclosed; user hooks disabled for both CLIs and a process poller watches for ai-memory hook processes.

7.label: fix-round preregistration, written after the independent review and before any fix-round rerun
7.expectation: Rerunning the upstream four-query retrieval assertion (examples/promptfoo-nemotron-upstream with NVIDIA's pinned model-card script) with -o results.json gives 4/4 and zero token/cost placeholders; vLLM prompt_tokens_total rises by about 336 over the run. The independently authored 30-case run with a provider that returns the endpoint's billed_units as promptfoo tokenUsage makes promptfoo report non-zero token usage matching the metric delta. Cost has no price source for the local endpoint, so expected outcome: advanced.
7.criteria: results.json tokenUsage/cost quoted for both runs; metric snapshots before/after each run and for a quiet control interval of similar length.
